paragraphs.text: Sponge is a creature type that represent sea sponges . They occur in large colonies. Adult sponges are sessile , meaning that they remain attached in one place; however, sponges in Magic: the Gathering are shown to be mobile.
So far, two Sponges have been printed, both in mono- blue .
Sponge debuted as a creature type on Walking Sponge from Urza's Legacy , and was seen again on Thought Sponge in Commander 2019 .
In Secret Lair Drop Series: SpongeBob SquarePants SpongeBob SquarePants was created as a skinned card without the sponge type, as there are currently no legendary sponges.
